description: This is the entry point of a React frontend application that initializes the React app by rendering the 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the created root, wrapping 'App' within React.StrictMode.
